turns.content: I need a LinkedIn post for the Fujifilm X100VI. Here are the facts: it has a 26.1MP APS-C X-Trans CMOS 4 sensor, a fixed 23mm f/2 lens, and it supports 4K video recording. Can you help me craft something professional using these details?

I created the draft and validated it against the confirmed product facts and requested constraints.

Introducing the Fujifilm X100VI, a powerful camera featuring a 26.1MP APS-C X-Trans CMOS 4 sensor for stunning image quality. This model comes equipped with a fixed 23mm f/2 lens, perfect for capturing sharp and vibrant photos. Additionally, it supports 4K video recording, allowing you to create high-resolution videos with ease. Elevate your photography and videography with the X100VI!
